create.title: Conditional radial-BV reduction for the beta double-bounded cell
create.statement_tex: Let A(x) be the exact endpoint-image-free beta-owned double-bounded amplitude after signed hard-top recombination and finite post-routing ownership. If sup_(1<=x<=N_X)|A(x)|+int_1^(N_X)|A'(x)|dx is O_epsilon(X^epsilon), then sqrt(X) int_1^(N_X) x^(-3/2-b/2)e(sqrt(Xx))A(x)dx is O_epsilon(X^epsilon). The exact identity has boundary [x^(-1-b/2)e(sqrt(Xx))A(x)]_1^(N_X)/(pi i) with full continuous endpoint coefficients; pre-existing profile and inversion stars retain their own values. The beta-masked endpoints must be estimated locally and may not be identified with the accepted unmasked three-mask endpoint module.
create.next_action: Apply this reduction only after the explicit compact amplitude and its value plus one-x-derivative bound have passed isolated validation.

create.title: Explicit target-sized beta double-bounded cell
create.statement_tex: For the exact beta-owned compact cell Theta_db=psi(beta)chi_0(alpha), with the full gamma unit phase, signed hard-top Plemelj functional, smooth ordinary-mu shares, complete finite connector/profile family, exact floors and stars, and all routed boundary modules excluded once, prove sup_x(|A(x)|+x|A'(x)|)=O_epsilon(X^epsilon). The candidate discovery and hostile proofs yield this bound by compact gamma control, a cancellation-preserving divided difference, absolute h and q convergence, and a polylogarithmic dyadic scale sum; an isolated verifier must still certify the explicit one-count assembly and local masked endpoints.
create.next_action: Freeze the finite post-routing amplitude term by term and assign an isolated verifier the exact formulas, profile seminorms, j range, and exclusion ledger.

reject.reason: Continuous radial integration by parts gives full endpoint coefficients. Half-values belong only to pre-existing profile, product-equality, or inverse-Mellin stars.
The accepted endpoint theorem applies after global three-mask recombination. A single beta-masked endpoint must be estimated locally or retained; it cannot be identified with the unmasked module.
Before delta/PV recombination the constant diagonal has a nonintegrable absolute height tail. The signed diagonal must be formed before absolute values.
A statement-only verifier cannot certify the complete connector, profile, scale, and boundary-module assembly unless the finite amplitude and exclusion ledger are explicitly supplied.
